title: Resize an image
summary: Resize to exact pixel dimensions without cropping. Set one dimension to 0 to preserve aspect ratio.
required_inputs: LoadImage: upload or select an image.
Resize: change width and height; set height to 0 to preserve aspect ratio. Choose upscale_method for interpolation; keep crop disabled.
limitations: Exact nonzero width and height can stretch the image.
Resampling only; no AI enhancement or restoration.
Requires a working Comfy runtime with the named core nodes. No models or custom node dependencies.
